description: This file defines the 'OpenmrsService' interface for the OpenMRS API, specifying lifecycle methods for startup and shutdown procedures for services within the framework.

classes.name: OpenmrsService
classes.description: Interface defining lifecycle methods for OpenMRS services, such as initialization and shutdown hooks.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Method invoked when the OpenMRS service layer is starting up or initializing.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Method invoked when the OpenMRS service layer is shutting down.
